verdict.rationale: Mem0 ships a first-party self-hosted option (Open Source / Docker stack), so you can run it on your own infrastructure and keep the data wherever that infrastructure lives. That is a documented way to control where data is stored. Nothing in the evidence shows region or residency selection on the hosted Platform. Missing for 10: region selection on the hosted Platform, documented data-residency guarantees or certifications, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)

citations.quote: Mem0 Open Source is the same memory engine as the Platform, running on your own infrastructure. You own the stack, the data, and every component
Self-host Mem0 with full control over your infrastructure and data
As a self-hosted server. A Docker stack with a dashboard, per-user API keys, and a request audit log.
